sanitizedNote: AuthPassword/encode la ma hoa client-side cua mat khau SIP (rong, chua cau hinh) - da rut gon/thay placeholder do do dai lon, khong dung gia tri that.
ghiChu: Dang xac_nhan_trong. instidentity: tu_truong:_InstIDVP - INSTIDENTITY echo gia tri cua truong _InstIDVP (IGD.SV.VS1.VP1.VL1), KHONG PHAI _InstID top-level (IGD.SV.VS1.VP1.VL1.LS). Day la mau hinh moi: 2 truong ID khac ten (_InstID va _InstIDVP) cung xuat hien, INSTIDENTITY echo truong 'phu' chu khong phai truong chinh. SIP Account chua duoc cau hinh (Basic bi chan client-side do SIP Account rong) nen cac gia tri deu rong/mac dinh.
